title: Force Git renormalization after an index entry already exists
failure_signature: Re-adding the CRLF index files with autocrlf enabled did not replace their existing staged blobs, and the second diff-hygiene check repeated the same findings.
candidate_workaround: When a text path already has an index entry, use Git's explicit renormalize mode rather than assuming a configuration change will refresh the blob.
recurrence_guard: After a line-ending repair, compare the staged object and rerun diff hygiene before trusting normal add.
rollback: Keep the commit blocked and restore the prior staged blob if renormalization changes semantic content.
scope_boundary: Bounded owner-local operational recovery only; no scientific, professional, authority, production, security-complete, accessibility-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
